_comment: Highlights for the next release. Update this file for EVERY code change,
not only immediately before a release.
One entry per change, written from the user's point of view, in the eight
interface languages. The rule is the same as for i18n.js: a text the user
reads exists in every language NaviXav speaks.
'fr' and 'en' are required; a missing language falls back to 'en'.
Aviation identifiers and METAR/MCDU notation stay unchanged in every
prepare_release.ps1 turns these entries into RELEASE_NOTES.md and its
localised siblings, and prepends a version section to CHANGELOG.md, the
history the application reads, then resets this file.

fixed.fr: Le fond de carte OpenStreetMap transmet désormais l’origine locale requise et ne reste plus bloqué par une erreur 403.
fixed.en: The OpenStreetMap basemap now sends the required local origin and is no longer blocked by a 403 error.
fixed.de: Die OpenStreetMap-Grundkarte übermittelt nun den erforderlichen lokalen Ursprung und wird nicht mehr durch einen 403-Fehler blockiert.
fixed.es: El mapa base de OpenStreetMap ahora envía el origen local requerido y ya no queda bloqueado por un error 403.
fixed.it: La mappa di base OpenStreetMap ora invia l’origine locale richiesta e non viene più bloccata da un errore 403.
fixed.nl: De OpenStreetMap-achtergrondkaart stuurt nu de vereiste lokale oorsprong mee en wordt niet langer geblokkeerd door een 403-fout.
fixed.pl: Mapa bazowa OpenStreetMap przekazuje teraz wymagane lokalne źródło i nie jest już blokowana błędem 403.
fixed.pt: O mapa base do OpenStreetMap agora envia a origem local exigida e já não é bloqueado por um erro 403.
